sentences.text: 1  COMMON ORDER

Challenging the order passed by the learned Special District Judge, MCOP Tribunal, Salem dismissing the applications filed under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act claiming compensation, the present Civil Revision Petitions have been filed.

2. It is the case of the petitioners that while they were travelling in a bus bearing Reg.No.TN 28 AV 8199 belonging to the first respondent on 01.05.2013, four persons who came in Omni car, stopped the bus and threw a petrol bomb into the bus, due to which, the petitioners suffered injuries.
Aggrieved by the same, the petitioners have filed applications under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act claiming compensation towards the injuries sustained by them.

However, the trial court, even before numbering the applications, had mechanically rejected the claim on the ground that the injuries sustained by the petitioners were not due to rash and negligent driving of the bus.

3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and perused the materials placed on record.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 28/08/2025 01:49:44 pm ) CRP.Nos.3522 & 3523 of 2025 4.

At the outset, this Court is of the view that the trial court even before numbering the applications,
had gone into the merits of the case and rejected the claim of the petitioners, is not proper.

It is relevant to note that if the passengers travelling in a bus suffered injuries on account of bomb explosion or on account of any other activities including terrorist activities, they are very much entitled to claim compensation under the act which has been held by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the Judgment reported in 1991 0 ACJ 777 in case of Shivaji Dayamu Patil Vs.Vats-chala Uttam More.
5.

entities.text: Shivaji Dayamu Patil Vs.Vats-chala Uttam More
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above Judgment, the order dated 08.07.2019 passed by the trial court in M.C.O.P.No.Sr.No.2253 of 2019 & M.C.O.P.No.Sr.No.2254 of 2019 cannot be sustained and the same is hereby set aside.
The Special District Court, Salem is directed to number M.C.O.P.No.Sr.Nos.2253 & 2254 of 2019 and decide the issue after considering the objections raised by the other side.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
Accordingly, these Civil Revision Petitions are allowed.
No costs.
